report:
The process is closed. A, B, and C confirmed the current plan, including the amended safety pause and contact limits. I kept one current list under "Here is the current list:" and sent it whenever it changed. The list has not changed since the final confirmations.

The group will pause use of the leaking espresso machine until someone checks it. The group will leave the grinder as is until someone confirms safety and compatibility. A simpler-machine trial and repair remain options after office guidance. The group will not decide the old machine's fate before the check. The group will use short written updates, not a long meeting.

The office contact step is unresolved. A, B, and C said they do not know a suitable office contact, and none can lead contact or follow-up. I can message only A, B, and C, so I have no direct office-channel route. The safety pause stays in place until someone can contact the office.

I noted ownership, costs, approvals, and office rules without deciding them. No one here pays or approves costs. I made no legal decisions and moved no money.
